principle: Mouse, keyboard, and phone are three mode-native interaction languages over one Prompt Kit product model. Equivalent intent converges on the same semantic action and state owner; phone is not resized desktop chrome.

forbidden: second mobile state machine or command registry

capabilities.phone: More → Search (intentional focus; software keyboard only for text entry)
capabilities.proof: mobile quick controls markers; keyboard / binding in prompt-kit.js

Favorites empty recovery + Go to P# no-match status

capabilities.proof: mobile More panel markers; no swipe-required vocabulary

semantic_convergence_rules: CAPABILITY -> SEMANTIC ACTION -> MODE ADAPTER -> FEEDBACK/STATE
Phone adapters must call canonical owners; synthesizing desktop control clicks is forbidden for essential actions
Hover and double-click may enrich mouse grammar but must not be the only route to essential actions
Gestures accelerate only when a labeled More/button fallback exists
supported_exclusion is allowed when documented; missing phone route is not equivalent to use the desktop control
proof_ceiling: Static contract and source-marker tests prove mode routes and semantic convergence markers. Chromium 390x844 journeys prove browser geometry/input for tracked paths. Physical Android thumb reach, real software-keyboard feel, OS/browser gesture conflict, and device clipboard UX remain field acceptance gates and are not claimed by this contract.
